The '''Upper West Side''' ('''UWS''') is a neighborhood in the [[Boroughs of New York City|borough]] of [[Manhattan]] in [[New York City]]. It is bounded by [[Central Park]] on the east, the [[Hudson River]] on the west, [[59th Street (Manhattan)|West 59th Street]] to the south, and [[110th Street (Manhattan)|West 110th Street]] to the north. The Upper West Side is adjacent to the neighborhoods of [[Hell's Kitchen, Manhattan|Hell's Kitchen]] to the south, [[Columbus Circle]] to the southeast, and [[Morningside Heights, Manhattan|Morningside Heights]] to the north.<ref>{{cite enc-nyc}}</ref>

Like the [[Upper East Side]] on the opposite side of Central Park, the Upper West Side is an affluent, primarily residential area with many of its residents working in commercial areas of [[Midtown Manhattan|Midtown]] and [[Lower Manhattan]]. Like the [[Museum Mile (Manhattan)|Museum Mile district]] on the Upper East Side, the Upper West Side is considered one of Manhattan's cultural and intellectual hubs, with [[Columbia University]] and [[Barnard College]] located just to the north of the neighborhood, the [[American Museum of Natural History]] located near its center, the [[New York Institute of Technology]] in the Columbus Circle proximity, and [[Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts]] and [[Fiorello H. LaGuardia High School]] located at the south end.

The Upper West Side is part of [[Manhattan Community Board 7|Manhattan Community District 7]], and its primary [[ZIP Code]]s are 10023, 10024, 10025, and 10069.<ref name="NYCPlanning"/> It is patrolled by the 20th and 24th Precincts of the [[New York City Police Department]].
